verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows generic SCIM protocol docs and building-a-SCIM-service guidance, plus event hooks, but nothing documenting HRIS-source-of-truth integration (e.g., Workday/BambooHR-driven provisioning) or automated joiner/mover/leaver flows into directory and app assignments. This is a well-known Okta capability area but is simply not evidenced here.
